measurands.name: lux
measurands.accuracy: approximately ±10% typical after calibration; enclosure window dominates error

failure_modes: zero at noon: sensor covered, enclosure window blocked, or gain misconfigured
reading is strictly local: a shadow on the sensor is not a dark room
saturation plateau in direct sun: gain/integration auto-ranging lag
mounting: orient toward the light field of interest; keep the window clean; note mounting in the deployment journal
